First Friday Social Ride

Lexington, KY · Downtown · Social

FamilyBeginner friendly

First Friday Social Ride is a social group ride in Lexington, KY. It rolls first Friday of the month at 6:00 pm from Gratz Park. About 5–8 miles, casual.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the First Friday Social Ride group ride

A family-friendly five-to-eight mile ride around downtown Lexington that ends at a local brewery. Casual pace, everyone welcome.
